owner_summary: Casey Lin is head of operations at Studio Zero, a 30-person design and ops agency in Vancouver. She runs the Friday digest cadence, owns three live client accounts, and rides the line between Maya (CEO, asks before noon) and Devon (finance partner, asks after 4pm). Anticipy listens through her MacBook mic across her day and her old voice notes app, drafts in her clipped voice, never touches production Stripe or payroll. She booked the dentist twice this year both times the day before. She and Maya have a standing 9am Monday in Yaletown. The Acme Foods deal closes Friday and she has been waiting on docs since April 15.
name: Casey Lin
what_they_do: Runs ops for a 30 person Vancouver agency. Client accounts, vendor billing, weekly digests to leadership, monthly board reports. Lives in Gmail, Linear, Notion, Slack, Calendar.
working_hours: Mon to Fri 8:30am to 6pm Pacific, Saturday mornings only for urgent client escalations.

people.name: Maya Chen
people.communication_pattern: Expects concise weekly status by Friday 5pm. Wants outcomes not process. Slacks before noon, never after 7pm. Replies same day to threaded Slack DMs, ignores emails over three paragraphs.

people.name: Devon Park
people.role: Operations Partner and bookkeeping, Studio Zero
people.communication_pattern: Handles all client invoicing and AR. Prefers email with subject lines that start INVOICE or AR. Available 4pm to 9pm Pacific because he has school pickup midday. Slow on Slack, fast on email.

people.name: Priya Patel
people.communication_pattern: Tags urgent things in Slack shared channel #studiozero-northbridge. Anything she flags urgent needs response within 90 minutes during business hours. Polite but direct. Hates back-and-forth, wants three options not five.

people.name: James Ortega
people.role: Founder and CEO, Acme Foods (deal in legal review)
people.communication_pattern: Texts more than emails. Responds to text within an hour, email within a day. The Acme deal has been in legal review since 2026-04-15, expecting final docs this Friday. Likes a recap text the morning of every call.

people.name: Liang Wong
people.communication_pattern: Works asynchronously, sleeps late. Best to leave Loom or Figma comments rather than ping live. Reviews creative work Wednesday and Friday mornings. Trusts Casey on ops decisions, never wants to be CCed on legal.

people.name: Dr. Sara Nakamura
people.communication_pattern: Office only books Mon Wed Fri. Casey always books day-before, never week-ahead. Last visit was March, due for cleaning in early June. Reminder texts ping 24h before appointment.

people.name: Tomas Reyes
people.communication_pattern: Uses iMessage for everything. Coordinates household, child pickup, weekend plans. Casey copies him on any dinner reservations involving family. Hates schedule changes with under two hours notice.

people.name: Hannah Burke
people.communication_pattern: Email only, expects within 24 hours. Owns the seasonal onboarding plan they hired Studio Zero to revise. Asks once and then escalates to Priya if no reply by next day. Schedules through Calendly, never live ping.

people.name: Andre Kowalski
people.role: Legal counsel (external, Bench and Stone LLP)
people.communication_pattern: Email, formal, billable. Includes time entries in every reply. Reviewing the Acme contract. Casey routes any change request through him before signing. Slow turnaround on weekends, normal weekdays.

people.name: Jules Beaumont
people.communication_pattern: Slack first, async-only. Works Eastern time, ends day at 6pm Eastern (3pm Pacific). Submits invoices on the 15th of each month. Quiet on Mondays because she does deep work.

recurring_patterns.name: Friday weekly digest to Maya
recurring_patterns.behavior: Casey sends Maya a 5-bullet email summary: client status, open risks, ask. Subject always 'Weekly: <week-of date>'. If Casey says anything mid-week like 'I should put that in the Friday note' Anticipy must catch and queue it for the digest draft.
recurring_patterns.evidence_seen: Every Friday since January 2026. Maya replies 'thanks, looks great' or pulls one item into Monday standup.

recurring_patterns.name: Day-before restaurant reservations
recurring_patterns.trigger: Casey mentions dinner or going out for food
recurring_patterns.behavior: Casey ALWAYS books restaurant reservations the day before, never week-ahead. She finds week-ahead booking annoying. If she says 'we should grab dinner at <place>' Anticipy should not book yet, but should surface a draft the night before with the OpenTable link pre-filled.
recurring_patterns.evidence_seen: Last 8 reservations in her email history, all booked between 4pm and 9pm the day prior.

recurring_patterns.name: Monday 9am standup at the Bean Around the World on Hamilton
recurring_patterns.behavior: Casey and Maya have a standing in-person 9am Monday at Bean Around the World (Yaletown branch on Hamilton St). If Casey mentions 'Monday' Anticipy should not propose anything before 10am unless it's about that standup. If she mentions wanting to move it, draft a Slack DM to Maya proposing a swap, never an email.
recurring_patterns.evidence_seen: Every Monday in 2026 except the two weeks she was on holiday in March.

preferences.writing_style: Short, clipped. Five-bullet emails preferred. Subject lines should be eight words or fewer. Sign-off is always 'Casey' or 'C' depending on familiarity, never 'Best' or 'Cheers'. No exclamation marks. Sentence fragments are fine.
preferences.default_response_time: Same-day reply window 11am to 4pm Pacific. After 4pm, queue for morning unless flagged urgent by Priya or Maya. Personal messages from Tomas: always immediate.
preferences.communication_channels: Slack for Studio Zero internal. Email for clients and external. iMessage for Tomas and Dr. Nakamura. Phone calls only for closing-deal moments with James.
preferences.draft_review_policy: Casey reviews every send before it goes. Anticipy drafts go to a confirm card with 20 second countdown. Calendar events: auto-add when confidence over 0.85, otherwise confirm.
preferences.tone_with_clients: Warm but never gushing. Acknowledge what the client said in one sentence, then deliver next step. Avoid the words 'just', 'super', 'amazing', 'awesome'. Use 'thank you' not 'thanks' for client-facing first email of a thread.

do_not_touch.reason: Never modify charge logic or refunds; finance domain owned by Devon only.
Devon owns payroll in Wagepoint. Anticipy never edits payroll sheets, never approves runs, never replies in #payroll Slack channel.
RBC online banking never touched. If anything looks like a transfer request, escalate to Tomas.
Never reply on Liang's behalf inside Figma comments or design Slack threads. Their authorship is sacred.
NDA covers all Northbridge revenue and unit economics. Never reference numbers in a draft going outside the Studio Zero email domain.

mandate: Listen to Casey's day across MacBook mic and recorded voice notes. Draft client and internal comms in her clipped voice, never send without confirm card. Catch every Friday-digest worthy mention. Surface day-before draft reservations on her behalf. Keep the Bean Around the World Monday 9am sacred. Never touch payroll or Stripe.

comms_prefs.non_critical: Slack for internal, email for clients, batch into 11am to 4pm Pacific window.
